integrity: Symbolic proof and exact finite-field code; the output is same-model reviewed but has not received independent expert or mechanized proof validation.
scientific_limitations: Requires a smooth cubic surface in characteristic two with a nonzero squarefree coefficient tensor and a canonical point outside the surface. Claims the fourth-power maximal-minor ideal of the ambient Gauss differential and the pointwise ranks, not properties of the dual-surface scheme or an arbitrary re-embedding. Historical priority provisional because an earlier paper could not be inspected in full. Finite-field tests alone do not establish universality.
title: Fourth-order Gauss ramification on smooth cubic surfaces in characteristic two
